conditions.added_solvent: none for the stated library protocol unless otherwise specified
conditions.analytical_evidence: Product drawings, IR, NMR and high-resolution ESI values are reported for selected controls. Source spectra are not independently reinterpreted here.
conditions.catalyst: none in the stated library protocol
conditions.locator: Main Methods: Library synthesis; SI p. 1 purification and characterization
conditions.precursor_scale: 200 mg of each amine per library reaction
conditions.stoichiometry: Acrylate library default two acceptors per amine, with specified exceptions; acrylamide library uses the maximal per-amine feed ratio. Feed ratio is not evidence that every site reacted. SI Table 1 records exceptions.
conditions.workup: Library mixtures cooled and used without purification unless specified. Selected compounds purified by silica chromatography using DCM/MeOH/NH4OH mixtures.

limitations.reason: The v8 O-series architecture label says full occupancy; the 2008 Methods uses a default 2:1 feed and explicit exceptions. Neither feed ratio nor that label establishes maximum substitution for every head.

Other acrylate source subfamilies (paracyclophane, ricinoleic and multiarm) still require their own source-specific occupancy and precursor-bank assignments. No source architecture is inferred by visual resemblance.

SI 1N12 lists fractional vinyl resonances although the displayed product is saturated. Preserve this analytical limitation; the computed control is not a claim of sample purity or independent experimental validation.
Computed reconstruction does not establish the chemical precision of corpus-wide inferred assignments. No source execution, yield, L2 or L3 label is admitted.

source_contract.coupling: The same complete acceptor is used at every declared event. N/O interfaces remain separate. No physical order inferred among commuting additions.
source_contract.missing_metadata: Exclude missing occupancy or component labels; do not infer full occupancy from available N-H sites.
source_contract.post_assembly: Methyl-iodide quaternization shown in Fig. 1 is a distinct optional step, absent from this program.
source_contract.reaction_sites: Non-acyl neutral primary/secondary amine N-H, terminal beta carbon of the bound ester or amide acceptor. Complete tail topology is preserved.
